first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so guarded onboarding simplification is the most direct intervention. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because prior gains came with higher early churn there. Verify memory_86 and compare its evidence with activation messaging in memory_91 before committing. final.rationale: Run shortened onboarding only for simple self-serve accounts, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts. The verified source shows a 13% completion lift and 2.1-day faster time-to-value, directly addressing the current onboarding decline, while the exclusion protects against the observed 9% churn increase in complex workspaces. Activation messaging remains a strong alternative, but targeted onboarding simplification addresses both completion and early adoption more directly. Measure qualified activation and downstream retention, not completion alone.
